scope: Resolved native profile v1; web catalogue membership does not imply native support.

components.limits: One profile-form; only submit/save-profile/profile-region is authorized.
Plain text; no HTML or executable content.
Up to 64 unique envelope-declared plain-text fields; no password/file/multiple input.
Explicit type=submit inside the registered form; no click/reset/named submitter.
Plain title/text and urgent accessibility announcement.
Boolean form field encoded as canonical true/false strings; disabled supported; no change network event.
Two-state boolean field using canonical true/false strings. Disabled supported; no indeterminate, readonly, required or change action.
Single choice from 1–64 unique nonempty string-valued options. Disabled supported; no placeholder, multiple selection or option-level modes.

verification: Source inventory, not a test certificate. Native workflow results for the exact commit establish platform compilation and simulator/emulator coverage. Accessibility, IME and physical-device behavior require separate validation.
